# SyncroDoc

> SyncroDoc reads a full set of plan governing documents and contracts, finds every
> difference, and cites the exact page and paragraph behind each finding. It is built for
> ERISA legal teams, multiemployer and Taft-Hartley fund administrators, and third-party
> administrators.

SyncroDoc is a product of SyncroDoc Systems LLC. https://syncrodocsystems.com

## Products

SyncroDoc is sold as a suite. A client licenses the product that fits its problem and turns on
more as needed. Every product runs on the same core.

- **Plan Operations Audit** (https://syncrodocsystems.com/products/plan-operations-audit/): checks the plan build used for claims setup against the carrier's benefit summary. Copays, deductibles, limits and exclusions are marked Match, Mismatch, Missing or Uncertain, each with the row it came from. Confirmed findings export as a marked-up plan build, with comments for the carrier drafted for review. For TPAs, fund offices and benefits operations teams.
- **Plan Merger Document Tool** (https://syncrodocsystems.com/products/plan-merger-document-tool/): compares the SPDs, plan documents and amendments of every plan in a merger provision by provision, matched by meaning, with each difference marked modified, added or removed and cited to its page. For multiemployer medical and pension plans in a merger, plan sponsors, ERISA counsel and benefits consultants.
- **Meeting Minutes Intelligence** (https://syncrodocsystems.com/products/meeting-minutes-intelligence/): reads years of board and committee minutes, groups discussions and decisions by topic on a timeline, and answers questions with a cited summary linked to the exact meeting and page. For fund administrators, board secretaries and counsel.
- **Fee Audit Tool** (https://syncrodocsystems.com/products/fee-audit-tool/): reads every line item on legal, actuarial and consulting invoices, groups spend by firm, category and period, and links every total back to its invoice lines. For fund administrators, trustees and finance committees.

The suite page is https://syncrodocsystems.com/products/

## Core capabilities

- Cross-plan comparison: two or more plans compared provision by provision, showing where documents agree, differ, or are silent, with page and paragraph cited.
- Amendment tracking: summaries of material modification mapped chronologically against the base plan document, with each provision marked unchanged, modified, added, or superseded.
- SPD restatement: a consolidated, current-state summary plan description generated from the amendment history, with citation trails intact.
- Contract analysis: service agreements and vendor terms read against each other or against a standard.

Documents up to 1,000 pages per file are handled, and every excerpt includes the exact page number and paragraph reference from the source.

## Who uses it

- Law firms with ERISA and benefits practice groups
- Multiemployer and Taft-Hartley fund administrators and trustees
- Third-party administrators (TPAs)
- Actuarial firms supporting fund governance
- Benefits consultants managing multiemployer plan mergers

## What makes it different

- Every governing document is read end to end on every run. No chunking, no sampling, so a definition on one page is not separated from the clause it governs on another.
- Provisions are matched by meaning against a library of plan structures rather than by format, so an unfamiliar drafting style does not require new development.
- Every answer carries the page and paragraph it came from, plus a record of how the conclusion was reached.
- Analysis of a full document set completes in minutes rather than the weeks manual cross-referencing takes.

## How it compares to a general-purpose AI chatbot

| | General-purpose chatbot | SyncroDoc |
|---|---|---|
| Provenance | No citations | Page and paragraph for every provision |
| Your documents | Become training data | Enterprise API instance; no training, contractually |
| Whole document | Chunked to fit a context window | Full document set read every time |
| Audit trail | A chat window | Reasoning and sources retained with every analysis |
| Repeatability | Same question, different answer | Constrained outputs and checks before release |
| Plan structure | Breaks on unfamiliar drafting | Mapped by meaning to a library of plan structures |

## Security

Single-tenant isolation, one dedicated environment per client. Client documents are never
used to train any model, and that prohibition flows down to the underlying AI provider.
Least-privilege access under Zero Trust with full action logging. Client data returned or
destroyed within 30 days of termination, with 72-hour security incident notification.

## Human review

Nothing is filed automatically. SyncroDoc does the reading and shows its sources; the
attorney, administrator or analyst keeps every decision. Output is a starting point for
professional review, not a substitute for it.
